messages:
incidents-bot: [ALERT] SLO breach detected — decode.p99 for streaming-api (us-west-2) crossed 2s. Auto-created INC-4632 and paged oncall.

ashley: I'm on it. seeing p95 jump ~120ms -> ~300ms, p99 ~380ms -> ~2100ms. streaming stalls reported from multiple regions (mostly us-west-2). Any recent infra or runtime changes?

ravi: pushed kernel image gk-2026-11-02-7ab earlier (TRT + flashattn v2). Started canary at ~12:18UTC, ~30% traffic.

maria: copying traces — decode loops show long NVTX sections in flash_attn_forward and long memcpy waits. sample:

```
[2026-11-02T12:32:11Z] batch=8 seq=1024 flash_attn_forward: 1213ms
[2026-11-02T12:32:11Z] kernel memcpy: 900ms wait
```

kevin: correlates with new compiler optimization flag '-O3 --use-fast-kernel' that landed in build 7ab. That flag changes memory layout for the fast path.

ashley: mitigation options: 1) rollback kernel to previous stable image (gk-2026-11-01-4f2) 2) if rollback takes long, flip runtime env to disable optimized flash path (REDWOOD_FLASHATTN_SAFE=1) 3) route critical customers to fallback nodepool. I'll start rollback.

ashley: executing rollback now.

deploy-bot: rollback started for nodepool=decode-usw2, target=gk-2026-11-01-4f2.
Command:
```
redwoodctl rollout rollback --nodepool decode-usw2 --to gk-2026-11-01-4f2 --timeout 10m
```

ravi: monitoring logs and canary metrics. also opened hotfix PR to remove the compiler flag from next build: https://github.com/redwood-inference/builds/pull/5243

support-bot: INC-4632 customer impact: streaming stalls >5s reported by cust-omega and cust-sigma (partial traffic). CSMs notified; working on templated customer note.

maria: after rollback p95 trending back to ~140ms, p99 down to ~420ms, error rate for streaming endpoints decreased to baseline. Some residual tail spikes remain.

ashley: enabling prefix caching for the most affected endpoints to reduce tail variability while we validate fixes.

ops-sre: documenting steps taken in INC-4632 and collecting artifacts: nvtx traces, kernel perf counters, canary traffic logs. tagging eng-runtime for postmortem.

ashley: handing off to ravi for overnight follow-up. Notes for handoff: root suspicion is an interaction between the new compiler optimization and flashattn v2 on particular sequence-length distributions causing kernel memcpy stalls. Next steps: revert flag in nightly, expand perf matrix, reproduce locally on longer sequences.

ravi: taking over. I'll run the full perf sweep, gather heap/nvtx traces, and prepare a patch that keeps the fast path gated by a runtime check until validated. Ping me if you see regressions.

ashley: oncall log updated. :white_check_mark: Handoff @ 2026-11-02T13:10:12Z

kevin: follow-up backlog item created: improve canary gating for combined kernel+compiler flag rollouts and add sequence-length specific unit tests to the governance harness.

incidents-bot: INC-4632 status -> mitigated; monitoring. Page closed.

ashley: drafting postmortem; ETA EOD tomorrow. cc: @product @support.
